uncited: **Marching Cache:** A shared memory buffer (typically GPU shared memory) containing voxel data required by the current ray bundle.
**Ray Front Synchronization:** Align the bundle of rays such that the ray front accesses the same data simultaneously.
**Cache Invalidation and Update Calculation:** Determine which part of the cache each ray needs to update when the cache becomes invalid.
**Incremental Cache Update and Rendering:** Incrementally update the cache in the direction of the rays as they traverse the volume.
Neighboring rays share fast memory to fill missing values.
